title: Rulers and Prophets Reproved

questions.question: And I said: Hear, you heads of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel! Is it not for you to know...?
questions.explanation: Micah 3:1 (ESV): "Is it not for you to know justice?"

questions.explanation: Micah 3:2 (ESV): "and their flesh from off their bones,"

questions.explanation: Micah 3:4 (ESV): "because they have made their deeds evil."

questions.explanation: Micah 3:5 (ESV): "who cry 'Peace' when they have something to eat,"

questions.question: Therefore it shall be night to you, without vision, and darkness to you, without...
questions.explanation: Micah 3:6 (ESV): "and darkness to you, without divination."

questions.explanation: Micah 3:7 (ESV): "the seers shall be disgraced, and the diviners put to shame;"

questions.explanation: Micah 3:8 (ESV): "to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin."

questions.explanation: Micah 3:10 (ESV): "who build Zion with blood and Jerusalem with iniquity."

questions.explanation: Micah 3:11 (ESV): "its prophets practice divination for money;"

questions.explanation: Micah 3:11 (ESV): "No disaster shall come upon us."

questions.question: Therefore because of you Zion shall be plowed as a...
questions.explanation: Micah 3:12 (ESV): "Therefore because of you Zion shall be plowed as a field;"

questions.question: Jerusalem shall become a heap of ruins, and the mountain of the house a...
questions.explanation: Micah 3:12 (ESV): "and the mountain of the house a wooded height."

questions.explanation: Micah 3:7 (ESV): "they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God."

questions.explanation: Micah 3:3 (ESV): "and chop them up like meat in a pot, like flesh in a cauldron."

questions.question: But if one puts nothing into their mouths, they declare war against him.
questions.explanation: Micah 3:5 (ESV): "but declare war against him who puts nothing into their mouths."

key_verse_text: But as for me, I am filled with power, with the Spirit of the Lord, and with justice and might, to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.
